title: Representation learning without labels; synthesis project
summary: PCA and autoencoder limits, ELBO and contrastive objectives, controlled representation evaluation and an executable cumulative synthetic learning project.

objectives.description: Derive PCA reconstruction and explain why unsupervised fit need not preserve a downstream label.
Derive contrastive and latent-variable objectives with correct normalisation and assumptions.
Design controlled representation comparisons without unacknowledged test-input access.
Implement and audit a reproducible small learning study integrating gradients, optimisation, regularisation, evaluation and architectural assumptions.

preparation.description: Read latent-variable models and autoencoder/VAE sections; separate reconstruction from a generative distribution.
Read representation similarity, self-supervised transformations/contrastive loss, biased-data controls and the downstream-task discussion.

activities.title: Lecture notes and primary reading
activities.instructions: Work through the notes with the assigned source open. Reproduce each worked calculation or derivation on paper, including its assumptions, before reading the next step. Write one question that remains unresolved.

activities.title: Problem sheet: calculation, explanation and transfer
activities.instructions: Attempt the problems independently first. Use one hint at a time if useful, and record which help you used. Show the reasoning that connects the model and its assumptions to each answer; compare the reference only after a substantial attempt.

activities.title: Return without the notes
activities.instructions: On a later study day, close the notes and reconstruct the core relation and its assumptions, then explain the failure case from the last problem. Compare with your saved work and correct one gap. This practice does not itself certify mastery.

exitCheck.description: Complete the cumulative train/break/explain project with executable model and gradient checks, train-only preprocessing and independent partitions, validation-selected checkpoints across all declared seeds, baselines and actual failures, representation/shift analysis and an architecture-based follow-up. Address all six weighted criteria; earlier mathematical and evidence-audit gaps remain part of the portfolio.

commonMisconceptions.claim: Low reconstruction error proves the best downstream representation.
commonMisconceptions.correction: High-variance nuisance information can dominate reconstruction while low-variance label information is discarded.

commonMisconceptions.claim: Self-supervised fitting cannot leak because labels are absent.
commonMisconceptions.correction: Test-input access changes the protocol and may adapt the representation to evaluation examples.

commonMisconceptions.claim: A contrastive loss denominator should omit the positive partner.
commonMisconceptions.correction: For the specified normalised candidate objective it includes the positive and all permitted negatives, excluding the anchor itself.
